Title: NodeClient.LlamaCpp — Implementation Status
Content: NodeClient.LlamaCpp is complete as of 2026-06-01 (next-gen branch, commit 1566611d). Five new files: LlamaCppClientOptions (BaseUrl, TimeoutSeconds, ModelLabel, NodeId, VramMb — all configurable), ILlamaCppClient (ExecuteAsync, StreamChunksAsync SSE, IsHealthyAsync, GetServerStatusAsync, ListModelsAsync), LlamaCppClient (true SSE parsing with doneSeen flag, event: line handling, malformed JSON tolerance), LlamaCppInferenceNode (health state mapping: ok=Healthy, loading model=Degraded, other=Unavailable; LatencyMs=TTLT documented). 41 NUnit tests (18 node tests + 23 SSE client tests). ProjectReference added to NodeWorker.csproj. Remaining polish (low priority): F1 ChatMessage.Content string?, F5 FakeHttpMessageHandler try/catch, F6 cancellation-mid-stream test.
